What I am trying to make is a menu with multiple links that, when clicked, change what section is shown using JavaScript, HTML and CSS. For some reason, though, onclick="showContent('x')" only works once, when you click on any button. Afterwards, clicking on any of the other buttons does not have any effect. Here is how my code currently looks like: function showContent(type) { let box = document.getElementById("content-box"); let source = document.getElementById(type); if (!box || !source) return; box.innerHTML = source.innerHTML;
